name: Kendrick
description: Domain-specific language (DSL) and modeling platform for specifying and simulating compartmental epidemiological models. Provides a high-level declarative language for defining model structure, parameters, and initial conditions, with support for both deterministic (ODE) and stochastic simulation. Enables formal model specification, automatic equation generation, and sensitivity analysis. Designed to lower the technical barrier for epidemiological modeling while maintaining mathematical rigor. Published in BMC Bioinformatics.
general_score_metric: scenario-based fit / goodness-of-fit metrics (e.g., RMSE, likelihood or other quantitative fit to reference epidemic trajectories)
reputation: Peer-reviewed epidemiological modeling DSL; published in BMC Bioinformatics
notes: Published in BMC Bioinformatics. Designed to integrate with R for statistical analysis. Supports SIR, SEIR, SIRS, and custom compartmental model structures. Enables stochastic simulation through the Gillespie algorithm.
